travelRole.question.1: Your friends decide to take a trip. What do you do first?
travelRole.question.1.a: Start organizing the schedule and bookings
travelRole.question.1.b: Get together and talk about places to go
travelRole.question.2: You have just arrived. What sounds best?
travelRole.question.2.a: Look up nearby restaurants or markets for a good-value meal
travelRole.question.2.b: Drop your bags and check the route from your stay
travelRole.question.3: Your group gets turned around at an unfamiliar station.
travelRole.question.3.a: Check the signs and map to find the way
travelRole.question.3.b: Head toward a place that looks interesting
travelRole.question.4.b: Take a moment to enjoy the view together
travelRole.question.5.a: Find a place to rest and check what they need
travelRole.question.5.b: Take a break and decide what to do next together
travelRole.question.6: When it is time to split trip expenses, you…
travelRole.question.6.a: Track what everyone spent and settle up
travelRole.question.6.b: Start by choosing something everyone wants to eat
travelRole.question.7.a: Quickly reorganize the rest of the day
travelRole.question.7.b: Lighten the mood: we're here, let's enjoy it!
travelRole.question.8: A block of free time suddenly opens up.
travelRole.question.8.a: Follow your curiosity and head somewhere
travelRole.question.8.b: Find a landmark or restaurant you wanted to visit
travelRole.question.9: What makes you happiest at the end of the trip?
travelRole.question.9.a: Laughing together and having lots of photos
travelRole.question.9.b: Wrapping up the plans and budget without a hitch
travelRole.profile.planner.name: The Itinerary Planner
travelRole.profile.planner.catchphrase: The trip starts with the plan!
travelRole.profile.planner.description: You keep the stay and routes in order so everyone can move around with ease. Once the plan is set, you can finally relax and enjoy the trip too.
travelRole.profile.navigator.name: The Human GPS
travelRole.profile.navigator.description: You read the signs and maps and keep the group from getting lost. Even when the route changes, you calmly find the next way forward.
travelRole.profile.foodie.name: The Food Scout
travelRole.profile.foodie.catchphrase: Every great trip needs a great meal.
travelRole.profile.foodie.description: You quickly find local favorites and snacks. You consider everyone's tastes and love sharing something new around the table.
travelRole.profile.photographer.name: The Memory Maker
travelRole.profile.photographer.descript: When the scenery is lovely, you bring everyone together for a picture. You make sure the group has memories to look back on after the trip.
travelRole.profile.mood-maker.name: The Mood Maker
travelRole.profile.mood-maker.catchphras: A change of plans can still be fun!
travelRole.profile.mood-maker.descriptio: You keep spirits up when things go differently than expected. Your jokes and easy conversation make the trip more fun for everyone.
travelRole.profile.budget-keeper.name: The Expense Tracker
travelRole.profile.budget-keeper.catchph: A tidy split makes a tidy finish.
travelRole.profile.budget-keeper.descrip: You naturally keep track of shared costs and settle the bill. You find ways for everyone to enjoy the trip without stretching the budget.
travelRole.profile.caregiver.name: The Group Caretaker
travelRole.profile.caregiver.catchphrase: Everyone should feel good on this trip.
travelRole.profile.caregiver.description: You check how everyone is doing and bring what the group needs. You notice when it is time to pause before anyone has to ask.
travelRole.profile.free-spirit.name: The Detour Explorer
travelRole.profile.free-spirit.catchphra: If it looks fun, let's go!
travelRole.profile.free-spirit.descripti: You turn an unexpected alley or view into a new stop. You find the fun in unplanned moments and give your friends a story they did not expect.
